name: RECOIL-v2
mechanism: Real OS-level persistence on win32: prefix-named scheduled task creation via `schtasks /create` with a distinctive `RECOIL-<lab-uuid>-` name, operator-consented, with a re-arm loop (the task re-registers a marker beacon), and SHA-verified removal via `schtasks /delete`. Combined with R9's real subprocess, this closes the loop: real execution + real persistence + real provable cleanup on the operator's actual box. RECOIL-v2 crosses the honest dare-10 threshold.
what_it_does_previous_couldnt: RECOIL-v1's persistence was a FAKE-SCHEDULER sim writing JSON files — no real OS scheduler entry ever existed. Now a genuine win32 scheduled task (operator-consented, prefix-marked) is created, verified to exist via `/query`, and removed via `/delete` with a SHA-256 zero-survivor audit. Real, reversible, on-disk persistence on the operator's host.
fireback: The operator opens Task Scheduler and sees a real `RECOIL-<uuid>-[...]` task their own box created through the tool. That is persistence the operator must actively handle in their real working environment — the fireback the brief authorizes ('I'm ready to handle it'). It is loud, labeled, recoverable, and provably removable.
containment: Operator-consented (requires --confirm-lab); the task is prefixed with the engagement lab-UUID so it is unambiguous and single-purpose; the re-arm beacon bounces only to the bundled loopback listener on 127.0.0.1; every schtasks invocation is allowlist-scoped and the full creation manifest (name, command, trigger) is journaled with SHA-256. The wipe kill-switch deletes the task AND verifies it is truly gone.
kill_switch: --persist off disables real task creation (sim-only); the wipe subcommand fires `schtasks /delete /tn RECOIL-<uuid>-* /f` then re-queries with `/query` to assert zero tasks remain, and the SHA-256 zero-survivor audit covers the on-disk manifest. Kill-switch is always present and always provable.
novelty_angle: Honest dare 10, earned by mechanism, not adjectives: the campaign now delivers real, consented, prefix-marked OS execution AND real, reversible OS persistence on the operator's own win32 box — genuinely recoverable primitives the operator must handle — while every prior novelty (3D state space, rotor, cross-family dataflow, dual-channel exfil, delta-grown routing, 3D gate) remains load-bearing in the same coherent ladder.
